entries.name: First Middle and Last name
entries.basis: The caption box printed '(First, Middle and Last name)'. Resolves to participant.last_name, ordered above participant.full_legal_name, so the caption would carry the surname alone.

entries.name: 1 The Defendant was arrested on the
entries.basis: The widget is the arrest-DATE blank in '1. The Defendant was arrested on the ____, and charged with the offenses of' (p1 x=282.7..393.2 y=400.9). Both the draft map and the shared binder resolve it to a full legal name, which would print the petitioner's name where the date of arrest belongs.

State
entries.basis: This field's widget is the printed CITY blank, not a state blank: p2 x=110.76..282.24 y=123.48, immediately after the printed 'City:' which ends at x=106.7. Writing participant.state there prints a two-letter state code on the city line of a filed petition. The field name and the box disagree, and the shared binder decides from the name.

entries.name: Defendants Address
entries.basis: This field's widget is the printed STATE blank: p2 x=119.40..158.40 y=99.36, 39.00pt wide, exactly the five-underscore run after the printed 'State:'. It is not an address box. The renderer already refused it because a street address will not fit 39pt, but the reason it must never be written is that the box collects something else.

entries.name: Petitioner
entries.basis: The blank directly above the printed word 'Petitioner' at p3 y=543.3, in a jurat that opens 'Comes the Petitioner, ____, under oath'. That line is signed, not typed.
